questions.title: FiberSpoolLength unit
questions.evidence_available: Aura and Rocket stores preserve FiberSpoolLength values, but the unit registries contain no supported first-party unit label.
questions.resolution_evidence: A FibreSeek field definition, UI label, schema, or direct vendor confirmation that names the Rocket unit.

questions.title: Rocket base/override runtime precedence
questions.evidence_available: Canonical Rocket observations preserve base and override values, but static evidence does not establish which value Rocket uses at runtime.
questions.resolution_evidence: Separately authorized offline Rocket behavior or first-party implementation documentation that establishes precedence.

questions.title: Cutter runtime precedence among 58, 55, and 54.8
questions.evidence_available: Structured CutDistance is 60 in Seeker Aura and 58 in Rocket; Rocket FiberRestartLength is 55; CutCode changes from a 55 comment to a 54.8 comment. Static evidence does not establish runtime precedence.
questions.resolution_evidence: Separately authorized Rocket output tracing or first-party implementation documentation proving how the structured field and CutCode comment are consumed.
